question:
Select the most appropriate option to complete the idiom in the following sentence.

I have a _______ thumb and I love gardening.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"green"** is often associated with nature, growth, and gardening. (हरा)

 
 
• **Example:** She has a **green thumb** and her garden is always blooming with flowers.
 
 
 
• **"Green thumb"** refers to someone who is naturally skilled at gardening. (हरा अंगूठा)
 
 
• **Example:** My grandmother has a **green thumb** and can grow any plant with ease.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **green**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Red** (लाल): Often associated with danger, passion, or alertness.

 
 
• **Example:** The red warning light indicated a problem with the engine.
 
 
 
• **Yellow** (पीला): Often associated with happiness, energy, and caution.
 
 
• **Example:** The yellow sunflowers brightened up the entire room.
 
 
 
• **Blue** (नीला): Often associated with calmness, stability, and sadness.
 
 
• **Example:** The clear blue sky is a beautiful sight to behold.
